purpose: Temporary compatibility overrides retained while Portal features are migrated to explicit composition.

overrides.reason: Two sequential presentation adapters rewrite legacy inline navigation and approved-mode home content.
overrides.exitCriteria: Move both transformations into the canonical home renderer and replace inline navigation with delegated actions.

overrides.reason: Derives the stay date range from the current application while the Portal still consumes shared global state.
overrides.exitCriteria: Expose a pure date-range selector/use case and inject its result into the activity editor.

overrides.reason: Composes activity form UI and enforces candidate/approved editability in the current global runtime.
overrides.exitCriteria: Move editability to shared domain rules/use case and keep the modal as a view adapter.
